decision.measured_failure_rule: an arm whose every learning-rate fit ended in a measured failure (non-finite training loss or CUDA out-of-memory) can never be adopted; the run continues past it and records the failure
decision.ordering: ascending unique parameter count; smallest passing arm is adopted

reference.bias_note: candidate-v2 trained on every selection row (it used the full 7,937-row train set), so its reference score is upward-biased and the +3.0-point margin is conservative for challenger arms, which never train on selection rows.
